topic: Indus river dolphin: lives in Pakistan's Indus river, is almost blind, and finds food using echolocation.

episode.title: Wild Superpowers: The Almost-Blind River Dolphin!

shots.narration: Did you know this almost-blind dolphin finds food using sound?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright naturalistic 3D animation, underwater in a sunlit muddy river, a cute anatomically accurate Indus river dolphin with tiny eyes and a long slender beak; no text.
shots.action: The Indus river dolphin glides toward the camera.
shots.mood: Golden sunbeams, sparkling suspended silt, inviting mystery.

shots.narration: Kiko and Pip explore Pakistan's Indus River, this dolphin's home.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny sandy bank of Pakistan's broad Indus River, green riverside vegetation; Kiko wears his green safari hat and pocketed khaki vest, Pip hovers beside him.
shots.mood: Bright blue sky, warm sunshine, eager discovery.

shots.narration: [surprised] But how can anything find food in this murky water?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, stable sandy riverbank set safely back from the water, Kiko's large binoculars aimed toward the cloudy brown river.
shots.mood: Puzzled expression, opaque water, gentle suspense.

shots.narration: The Indus river dolphin is almost blind.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, naturalistic underwater close-up of an Indus river dolphin's head, tiny eye and long beak visible against suspended river silt.
shots.action: The dolphin passes sideways across the frame.
shots.mood: Soft filtered sunlight, curious and gentle.

shots.narration: Its superpower is echolocation: finding things with returning sound.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, underwater river channel with one Indus river dolphin and a rounded submerged rock; faint translucent arcs illustrate sound, not actual light.
shots.action: Illustrative sound arcs spread from the dolphin toward the rock.
shots.mood: Clear visual discovery, warm underwater colours.

shots.narration: [excited] Echoes bounce back from objects around it!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same muddy underwater channel, rounded rock opposite the Indus river dolphin; translucent arcs are an illustrative sound visualization.
shots.action: Illustrative echo arcs travel from the rock back toward the dolphin.
shots.mood: Soft glowing sunlight, satisfying moment of understanding.

shots.narration: Those echoes help the dolphin find food.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, murky Indus riverbed with rippled sand and scattered smooth stones, one anatomically accurate river dolphin.
shots.action: The dolphin angles its long beak toward the riverbed.
shots.mood: Calm confidence, golden underwater haze, no visible prey.

shots.narration: Cloudy water? This dolphin has another way to explore!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny riverbank safely away from the edge, Kiko beside hovering emerald-green Pip, dolphin visible surfacing in the distant river.
shots.mood: Delighted smiles, bright river reflections, cheerful payoff.

shots.narration: [whispers] Can you guess our next animal, a master of camouflage?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, leafy riverside vegetation behind the sandy bank, Kiko with binoculars and Pip beside his green hat; no additional animal visible.
shots.action: Kiko lifts his binoculars toward the foliage.
shots.mood: Playful curiosity, sun-dappled leaves, inviting mystery.

episode.endHook: Can you guess our next animal, a master of camouflage?
episode.description: Explore Pakistan's Indus River with Kiko and Pip to discover the Indus river dolphin. This almost-blind dolphin uses echolocation to find food in murky water!
